start: Gym tab, My gym, member with a running plan, server has 0044, online

user_sees: Sheet 'Pause my plan' with 'Tap the first day you will be away, then the last day. The desk adds those days to the end of your plan.'
A month calendar starting this month, hint 'Tap the first day of your pause.'
must_not: Days before today that can be picked
A month before this one reachable

steps.action: Tap the first day, then the last day
user_sees: 'Now tap the last day of your pause.' then both days marked
'Send to the desk' turns on
must_not: Send on with only one day picked

user_sees: The sheet closes
Line 'Pause <from> to <to> (<n> days). Request sent. The desk will confirm.' and 'Take back my request'
'Pause my plan' hidden while it waits
must_not: Two requests from a double tap
'1 days' for a one-day pause

steps.action: Desk approves; member opens My gym again
user_sees: 'Your plan is paused. It now ends <date>.' and 'Got it'
must_not: The old end date on the card after the approval

start: Gym tab, My gym, member wants a new plan

user_sees: Sheet 'Renew my plan' with 'Pick a plan. The desk sets it up, and you pay at the desk.' and the gym's plans
Or 'Your gym has no plans to pick here yet. Ask the desk.'
must_not: Plans of another gym
A pay step in the app

steps.action: Pick a plan and tap 'Send to the desk'
user_sees: 'Renew: <plan>. Request sent. The desk will confirm.'
must_not: The plan shown as renewed before the desk acts

user_sees: 'Renewed: <plan>, <start> to <end>. Pay at the desk if you have not yet.'
must_not: 'Renewed' when the desk declined

start: Ask a trainer locked for a member with no plan; tap 'Renew my plan' there

steps.action: Tap 'Renew my plan' under the locked 'Ask a trainer'
user_sees: The Gym tab scrolls to the top and the 'Renew my plan' sheet opens once
must_not: The sheet opening again on every visit
Nothing happening when the gym has no plans to pick

start: Pause sheet, wrong dates and refusals

steps.action: Pick a first day more than 90 days ahead, or a pause longer than 365 days
user_sees: 'A pause can start up to 90 days from today.' or 'A pause can be up to 365 days.'
must_not: The request sent anyway

user_sees: 'You already asked for this. The desk will answer soon.' / 'You need an active plan to pause. Ask the desk.' / 'Your gym is not taking requests in the app right now. Ask the desk.'
must_not: The sheet closing as if sent
A raw code such as ALREADY_ASKED

user_sees: 'Couldn't send it. Check your internet and try again.' in the sheet
must_not: 'Request sent' for a send that failed

start: My gym, a waiting request taken back, and a declined one seen

steps.action: Tap 'Take back my request' on a waiting pause
user_sees: The line goes and 'Pause my plan' comes back
must_not: The request still waiting at the desk
The whole plan-request area gone with no word when offline

steps.action: Desk declines a renew request; member opens My gym
user_sees: 'Renew: <plan>. The desk could not do this request. Please ask them.' and 'Got it'
must_not: A declined request shown as approved

user_sees: The answered lines go; they do not come back next visit (the gym is told they were seen)
must_not: The same answer shown again every visit when online

start: My gym, member asks for a pause

user_sees: Only this member's own requests on the card
must_not: Another member's request or plan on the card
The request reaching another gym's desk
